#include <iostream>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

class TextDocumentAnalysis {
public:
    static string input(const string& str) {
        int len = str.length();
        bool open = false;
        int wc = 0;
        int max = 0;
        int wlen = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < len; ++i) {
            char ch = str[i];
            if (ch == '(') {
                if (wlen > 0) {
                    if (wlen > max) max = wlen;
                    wlen = 0;
                }
                open = true;
            } else if (ch == ')') {
                if (wlen > 0) {
                    wc++;
                    wlen = 0;
                }
                open = false;
            } else if (ch == '_') {
                if (wlen > 0) {
                    if (open) {
                        wc++;
                    } else {
                        if (wlen > max) max = wlen;
                    }
                    wlen = 0;
                }
            } else {
                wlen++;
            }
        }
        if (wlen > 0) {
            if (open) {
                wc++;
            } else {
                if (wlen > max) max = wlen;
            }
        }
        return to_string(max) + " " + to_string(wc);
    }
};

int main() {
    string line;
    while (getline(cin, line)) {
        // discard first line
        string line2;
        if (!getline(cin, line2)) break;
        cout << TextDocumentAnalysis::input(line2) << endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
